verifications.claim: Robert Mueller was FBI director from 2001 to 2013.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mueller was appointed FBI director in 2001 ... resigning in 2013." (R1); "Mueller served as FBI director from 2001 to 2013." (R2); "Mueller served as the FBI director from 2001 to 2013." (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the exact tenure.

verifications.claim: Robert Mueller was special counsel for the Russia investigation.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "In 2017, he was tapped ... to serve as special counsel in charge of the investigation into potential coordination ... and Russia." (R1); "the Justice Department appointed him special counsel to investigate potential coordination between Russia and the Trump team" (R2)

verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Bob passed away" on Friday (R2, article dated March 21, 2026, Saturday); "died on Friday at 81" (R4, dated March 21, 2026)
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify death on Friday prior to Saturday March 21 articles, contradicting March 21.

verifications.claim: Robert Mueller died at the age of 81.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "has died ... He was 81." (R2); "died ... at 81." (R4); "passed away at the age of 81." (R6)

verifications.claim: In September 2025, the House Oversight Committee withdrew a subpoena for Robert Mueller.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Article dated September 1, 2025: "has withdrawn a subpoena" (R1); "In September 2025, Mueller was subpoenaed ... but the request was withdrawn" (R2)

verifications.claim: The House Oversight Committee is chaired by Rep. James Comer.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Rep. James Comer of Kentucky, the chairman of the House Oversight Committee" (R1); "Chairman James Comer" (R3)

verifications.claim: The subpoena for Robert Mueller was regarding the investigation into the Justice Department's handling of the Jeffrey Epstein sex trafficking case.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "A House committee investigating the Justice Department's handling of the Jeffrey Epstein sex trafficking case has withdrawn a subpoena to former FBI Director Robert Mueller" (R1)

verifications.claim: The subpoena for Robert Mueller was withdrawn after it was learned that Mueller had been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "subpoena was withdrawn after the panel learned of unspecified health issues ... diagnosed with Parkinson's disease" (R1); "withdrawn its request ... has health issues ... new report says he has Parkinson's disease" (R3)

verifications.claim: Robert Mueller was diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease in the summer of 2021.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in the summer of 2021" (R1); "Bob was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in the summer of 2021" (R3)

verifications.claim: The House Oversight Committee sought testimony from Robert Mueller regarding the 2008 non-prosecution agreement.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Mueller was FBI director during an earlier Justice Department investigation of Epstein that resulted in a non-prosecution agreement ... for testimony about the years-long investigation into Epstein" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: Subpoena linked to Epstein investigation during Mueller's tenure when NPA occurred, but not explicitly 'regarding the 2008 non-prosecution agreement.'

verifications.claim: The 2008 non-prosecution agreement allowed Jeffrey Epstein to plead guilty to state charges in Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "a non-prosecution agreement that allowed the wealthy financier to plead guilty to state charges in Florida." (R1)

verifications.claim: Mueller was head of the FBI at the time of the 2008 non-prosecution agreement.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mueller was FBI director during an earlier Justice Department investigation of Epstein that resulted in a non-prosecution agreement" (R1)
verifications.reasoning: Directly states his role during that time.

verifications.claim: Mueller’s name appeared in files related to Jeffrey Epstein.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mueller's name also came up in the documents related to Epstein ... Trump's name came up along with Mueller's." (R6)

verifications.claim: According to a Hindustan Times report on the Epstein files as of March 2026, communications between associates of Epstein mentioned Mueller in the context of his appointment as special counsel for the Trump-Russia probe.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "communication from Nicholas Ribis to Epstein. “Robert Mueller appointed Special Counsel on Russian Probe bad for DJT” ... May 17, 2017-- that Mueller was appointed special counsel." (R6, Hindustan Times)
verifications.reasoning: Hindustan Times (R6) details exact context in Epstein-related files.

verifications.claim: President Donald Trump made hostile remarks regarding Robert Mueller on Truth Social following the announcement of Mueller's death on March 21, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Trump addressed Mueller's death on Truth Social. 'Robert Mueller just died. Good, I'm glad he's dead. He can no longer hurt innocent people!'" (R2, dated March 21, 2026); similar quote (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Hostile remarks confirmed post-announcement on March 21 articles; minor vagueness on exact announcement date but context matches.
